expected_invariant: A response counts as released only after the transaction context exits successfully; candidate bytes staged inside a transaction that raises scaffold_incomplete or rolls back must never populate release evidence.
observed_error: In TX-S09 cross_artifact_mismatched, the harness assigned _stage_complete output to response_bytes before delete_confirm_locked_transaction completed. The context then correctly raised DeleteConfirmScaffoldIncomplete and rolled back, but the local candidate remained non-null, so the harness failed at TX-S09_disclosed_bytes even though no external response was released.
detection_method: The one final authorized occupied attempt stopped at exact minimized code TX-S09_disclosed_bytes with empty-detail digest and cleanup_verified. Static inspection shows response_bytes is assigned inside the transaction context and is not cleared when scaffold_incomplete is caught; no product-service contradiction is identified by this evidence.

correction.action: If Yuri authorizes a new bounded recovery, separate candidate_response_bytes from released_response_bytes, promote the candidate only after successful transaction-context exit, prove incomplete and outer-abort paths release zero bytes, and define a new exact attempt budget before runtime.
correction.prevention_control: Transaction rehearsals must model candidate construction, durable commit and external release as separate states; only post-context-success promotion may enter disclosure evidence.
